title: An operator receives a weekly waitlist digest
description:
**Phase 2 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the scoring and disqualification stories
- **Runs in parallel with:** the invitation story
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
New signups, the score distribution, the disqualified count, the price answers so far, and **the full text of every free-text answer describing the work they want done.**

That last part is the point. At beta volume, reading those verbatim is worth more than any chart, and a digest that summarizes them into a count throws away the only qualitative signal the funnel produces. The free-text answer is also the lead: someone who writes a brief has told you they have already thought about it, and quoting it back at them is what the 48-hour reply is made of.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

Feature: Waitlist triage

  Scenario: The weekly digest carries the qualitative answers in full
    Given waitlist signups confirmed during the week
    When the weekly digest is produced
    Then it reports the new signup count and the score distribution
    And it reports the disqualified count
    And it includes the full text of each free-text work description

  Scenario: A quiet week still reports
    Given no waitlist signups confirmed during the week
    When the weekly digest is produced
    Then it reports that there were none
